description: Validate an existing or proposed import map: every UNPKG URL resolves, files exist, versions are mutually consistent (including react/react-dom pairing and duplicate-version skew), loose specs are flagged, and framework-managed packages are errors when a framework is given or detected. Run this after generate_importmap or an audit, before committing to a conversion.

imports.description: The import map's imports object: bare specifier to URL.

name: check_importmap
title: Validate an import map as a system
